title: Creators
subtitle: Associate your work with a shared coordination layer. PonyLife does not manage, monetize, or guarantee outcomes.

sections.heading: What it means to associate a work
sections.body: Your work becomes visible within a shared ecosystem. It can be discovered and promoted by independent participants. You retain full ownership and control.

sections.heading: What PonyLife does not do
sections.body: PonyLife does not sell your work, does not promise visibility, does not manage promotion, and does not guarantee outcomes. This is participation, not representation.

sections.heading: What creators receive
sections.body: Creators may receive participation units (PNL) and benefit from an experimental visibility context. Any outcomes remain uncertain and independent.

sections.heading: Submission (MVP)
sections.body: In the MVP stage, submissions are handled via a simple form or contact channel. Acceptance is not guaranteed.
